fs-adapt:heroes.actions.catch-breath.rul.en:
A creature who uses the Catch Breath maneuver spends a Recovery and regains Stamina equal to their recovery value.

A creature who is dying can’t use the Catch Breath maneuver, but other creatures can help them spend Recoveries in other ways.
fs-adapt:heroes.actions.catch-breath.rul.zh:
若你使用喘息機動動作，你會花費 1 點復元力，並恢復等於復元值的體力。

瀕死的生物無法使用喘息機動動作，但其他生物可以用其他方式協助他們花費復元力。

fs-adapt:heroes.actions.charge.rules.en:
When a creature takes the Charge main action, they move up to their speed in a straight line, then make a melee free strike against a target when they end their move. If the creature has an ability with the Charge keyword, they can use that ability against the target instead of a free strike.

A creature can’t move through difficult terrain or shift when they charge. They can fly or burrow as part of the Charge main action if they have that movement available to them, but they can’t climb or swim while charging unless they can automatically use that movement at full speed.
fs-adapt:heroes.actions.charge.rules.zh:
當你執行衝鋒主要動作時，你會以直線方式移動最多等於自身速度的距離，然後在移動結束時對 1 個目標發動 1 次近戰基礎打擊。若你擁有帶有「衝鋒」關鍵詞的招式，你也可以發動該招式來取代基礎打擊。

你在衝鋒期間無法穿越困難地形或進行遁移。若你擁有相應的移動能力，你可以在衝鋒期間飛行或掘地，但在衝鋒期間無法攀爬或游泳，除非你能夠自動以全速進行這類移動。

fs-adapt:heroes.actions.defend.rules.en: When a creature takes the Defend main action, ability rolls made against them have a double bane until the start of their next turn. Additionally, you have a double edge on tests when called for to resist environmental effects or a creature’s traits or abilities. A creature gains no benefit from this action while another creature is taunted by them.
fs-adapt:heroes.actions.defend.rules.zh: 若你執行防禦主要動作，針對你進行的所有招式檢定都會承受雙劣勢，直到你下個回合開始。此外，若你被要求進行考驗來抵抗環境效果、生物的特性或招式，你的考驗會獲得雙優勢。若有其他生物正被你嘲諷，你無法從此動作中獲得任何好處。

fs-adapt:heroes.actions.escape-grab.rule.en: You take a bane on this maneuver if your size is smaller than the size of the creature, object, or effect that has you grabbed.
fs-adapt:heroes.actions.escape-grab.rule.zh: 若擒抱你的生物、物體或效果的體型 > 你的體型，你進行此招式會承受 1 個劣勢。

fs-adapt:heroes.actions.free-strike.rule.en: A creature can use this main action to make a free strike.
fs-adapt:heroes.actions.free-strike.rule.zh: 你可以使用此主要動作來發動 1 次基礎打擊。

fs-adapt:heroes.actions.grab.rules.en: You can usually target only creatures of your size or smaller. If your Might score is 2 or higher, you can target any creature with a size equal to or less than your Might score.
fs-adapt:heroes.actions.grab.rules.zh: 你通常只能擒抱體型 ≦ 你的生物。若你的力量為 2 以上，則可以擒抱體型 ≦ 你力量的生物。

fs-adapt:heroes.actions.hide.rules.en: Using the Hide maneuver, a creature attempts to hide from other creatures who aren’t observing them while they have cover or concealment.
fs-adapt:heroes.actions.hide.rules.zh: 若你具有掩護或遮蔽，你可以使用躲藏機動動作，嘗試躲避沒有觀察到你的其他生物。

fs-adapt:heroes.actions.knockback.rules.en: You can usually target only creatures of your size or smaller. If your Might score is 2 or higher, you can target any creature with a size equal to or less than your Might score.
fs-adapt:heroes.actions.knockback.rules.zh: 你通常只能擊退體型 ≦ 你的生物。若你的力量為 2 以上，則可以擊退體型 ≦ 你力量的生物。

fs-adapt:heroes.actions.make-or-assist-t.en:
Many tests are maneuvers if made in combat. Searching a chest with a Reason test, picking a door’s lock with an Agility test, or lifting a portcullis with a Might test would all be maneuvers. Assisting a test is also a maneuver in combat.

Complex or time-consuming tests might require a main action if made in combat—or could take so long that they can’t be made during combat at all. Other tests that take no time at all, such as a Reason test to recall lore about mummies, are usually free maneuvers in combat. The Director has the final say regarding which tests can be made as maneuvers.
fs-adapt:heroes.actions.make-or-assist-t.zh:
在戰鬥中，許多考驗都屬於機動動作。例如用理智考驗來搜索寶箱、用敏捷考驗來打開門鎖，或用力量考驗來抬起閘門等，都算是機動動作。在戰鬥中協助他人進行考驗同樣也是機動動作。

在戰鬥中，較複雜或耗時的考驗可能需要使用主要動作來執行，甚至可能耗時太久而根本無法在戰鬥中完成。另一方面，幾乎不花時間的考驗通常屬於免費機動動作（例如用理智考驗來回想木乃伊的相關知識）。哪些考驗可以作為機動動作進行，最終由導演決定。

fs-adapt:heroes.actions.ride.rules.en: A creature can take the Ride move action only while mounted on another creature. When a creature takes the Ride move action, they cause their mount to move up to the mount’s speed, taking the rider with them. Alternatively, a creature can use the Ride move action to have their mount use the Disengage move action as a free triggered action. A creature can use the Ride move action only once per round. A mounted creature can only have this move action applied to them once per round. This movement can be broken with the rider’s maneuver and main action however they wish.
fs-adapt:heroes.actions.ride.rules.zh: 你必須騎乘在其他生物身上才能使用騎乘移動動作。當你使用騎乘移動動作時，坐騎可以載你移動最多等於坐騎速度的格數。或者，你也可以使用騎乘移動動作，讓坐騎以免費反應動作執行撤離移動動作。你每輪只能使用 1 次騎乘移動動作，而坐騎每輪也只能被施加此移動動作 1 次。你可以隨意將這段騎乘拆分到其他機動動作和主要動作之間。

fs-adapt:heroes.actions.search-for-hidde.en: The Search for Hidden Creatures maneuver allows a creature to attempt to locate creatures hidden from them.
fs-adapt:heroes.actions.search-for-hidde.zh: 你可以使用搜索隱藏生物機動動作來嘗試尋找對你隱藏的生物。

fs-adapt:heroes.actions.use-consumable.r.en: Unless otherwise noted in its description, a creature can activate a consumable treasure such as a potion with the Use Consumable maneuver. A creature can use this maneuver to administer a consumable treasure that benefits the user either to themself or to a willing adjacent creature.
fs-adapt:heroes.actions.use-consumable.r.zh: 除非另有說明，否則你可以透過使用消耗品機動動作來啟動消耗品（例如藥水）。若某件消耗品能讓使用者受益，你可以使用此機動動作將該消耗品使用在自己身上，或是使用在相鄰且自願的生物身上。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.b.en: Your powerful legs improve your speed. Your Speed is 6.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.b.zh: 你強壯的雙腿能讓你跑得更快。你的速度為 6。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.g.en: Whenever you take damage from a creature, you can use a triggered action to deal that creature psychic damage equal to 1d10 + your level.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.g.zh: 每當你受到生物造成的傷害時，你可以使用反應動作，對該生物造成等於 1d10 + 你等級的心靈傷害。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.i.en: Your cherished horns are larger than your average devil’s, and a hardened representation of your force of will. Whenever you make a saving throw, you succeed on a roll of 5 or higher.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.i.zh: 你珍愛的雙角比一般魔鬼的更大，是你堅定意志力的象徵。每當你進行豁免時，擲出 5 以上就算成功。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.en: Your hardened scales grant you damage immunity equal to your level to one of the following damage types: acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, or poison. You can change your damage immunity type when you finish a respite.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.zh: 你堅硬的鱗片會提供以下其中 1 種傷害類型的免疫（免疫值等於你的等級）：酸蝕、寒冷、腐朽、火焰、閃電、毒素。每次完成休整時，你可以更改傷害免疫的類型。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.en: You possess wings powerful enough to take you airborne. While using your wings to fly, you can stay aloft for a number of rounds equal to your Might (minimum of 1 round) before you fall prone. While using your wings to fly at 1st, 2nd, and 3rd level, you have damage weakness 5.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.zh: 你強壯的翅膀能帶你飛上天空。當你使用翅膀飛行時，你最多可以在空中停留等於你力量的輪數（至少 1 輪），之後就會墜落。若你在 3 級以下使用翅膀飛行，你會擁有傷害弱點 5。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.dwarf.signatu.en:
You can carve a rune onto your skin with 10 uninterrupted minutes of work, which is activated by the magic within your body. The rune you carve determines the benefit you receive.

You can have one rune active at a time, and can change or remove a rune with 10 uninterrupted minutes of work.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.dwarf.signatu.zh:
你可以花費不間斷的 10 分鐘在皮膚上銘刻符文，這些符文會透過你體內的魔力啟動。你銘刻的符文類型會決定你獲得的效果。

你同時只能啟動 1 種符文。更改或移除符文都需要不間斷的 10 分鐘。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.dwarf.signatu.en: Your skin sheds light for 10 squares. You can turn this on and off as a maneuver.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.dwarf.signatu.zh: 你的皮膚會發出照亮 10 格範圍的光芒。你可以使用機動動作開啟或關閉這道光芒。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.g.en: Your hearty constitution prevents you from losing strength.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.g.zh: 你強健的體魄讓你不會失去力量。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.g.en: Your heavy stone body and connection to the earth make it difficult for others to move you.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.g.zh: 你岩石般的厚重身軀與大地緊密相連，讓他人難以移動你。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.s.en: Your stone skin affords you potent protection.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.s.zh: 你的石質皮膚能為你提供強大的防護。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.s.en: Your body is made to withstand the blows of your enemies.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.s.zh: 你的身軀天生能承受敵人的猛烈攻擊。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.s.en: You have a magic connection to the earth. When you spend 1 uninterrupted hour singing, you can reshape any unworked mundane stone within 3 squares. You can’t destroy this stone, but you can move each square of it anywhere within 3 squares of you, piling it off to one side to dig a hole or building it up to create a wall.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.s.zh: 你與大地有著魔法的連結。若你花費 1 小時不間斷地歌唱，你可以重塑 3 格內任何未加工的尋常石材。你無法摧毀這些石材，但可以將每 1 格的石材移動到 3 格內的任意位置。例如將岩石搬到旁邊來挖出坑洞，或堆疊起來建造牆壁。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.hakaan.descri.en: In spite of their friendly, outgoing nature, the rare presence of a hakaan in human society is considered a harbinger - an omen of dark times. Descended from a tribe of giants in upper Vanigar, the original Haka’an tribe made a bargain with Holkatja the Vanigar trickster god. They traded some of their gigantic size and strength for the ability to see the future.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.hakaan.descri.zh: 儘管哈肯人天性友善外向，但只要他們罕見地出現在人類社會中，都會被視為黑暗的預兆。哈肯人源自北方華尼伽的巨人部落，最早的哈肯人部落與華尼伽的詭計之神霍卡提雅達成交易，用部分體型和力量換取了預見未來的能力。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.hakaan.trait..en:
Working with your Director, you can predetermine an encounter in which you will die. When that encounter begins, you become doomed. While doomed, you automatically obtain a tier 3 outcome on tests and ability rolls, and you don’t die no matter how low your Stamina falls. You then die immediately at the end of the encounter, and can’t be returned to life by any means.

If you don’t predetermine your death encounter, you can choose to become doomed while you are dying with the Director’s approval (no action required). Doing so should be reserved for encounters in which you are dying as a result of suitable heroism, such as making a last stand against a boss or saving civilians, or when the consequences of your actions have finally caught up to you — not because you’re playing a one-shot and have nothing to lose, Hacaarl.

Additionally, when your Stamina reaches the negative of your winded value and you are not doomed, you turn to rubble instead of experiencing death. You are unaware of your surroundings in this state, and you can’t regain Stamina or have this effect undone in any way. After 12 hours, you regain Stamina equal to your Recovery value.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.hakaan.trait..zh:
與你的導演合作，你可以預先決定哪場遭遇你將會死亡。當該遭遇開始時，你會進入「命定」狀態。處於命定狀態時，你進行的任何考驗和招式檢定都會自動獲得 T3 結果，而且無論你的體力降到多低都不會死亡。然而，你會在遭遇結束時立刻死亡，而且無法透過任何方式復活。

若你沒有預先決定死亡遭遇，你也可以在陷入瀕死時進入命定狀態（無需動作，但需經導演同意）。這種選擇應該保留給因為英勇行為而瀕死的情況，例如與首領殊死一戰、拯救平民，或因為先前的行為而遭遇相應的後果，而不是單純因為你只玩一場冒險而沒有顧忌。

此外，若你的體力降至疲態值的負數，但未處於命定狀態，你會變成碎石，而非死亡。在這種情況下，你無法感知周圍環境，也無法以任何方式恢復體力或復原。在 12 小時後，你會恢復等於你復元值的體力。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.hakaan.trait..en: Your hearty constitution prevents you from losing strength.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.hakaan.trait..zh: 你強健的體魄讓你不會失去力量。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.hakaan.trait..en: Your body is made to withstand the blows of your enemies.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.hakaan.trait..zh: 你的身軀天生能承受敵人的猛烈攻擊。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.high-elf.sign.en: A magic glamor makes others perceive you as interesting and engaging. This glamor makes you appear and sound slightly different to each creature you meet, since what is engaging differs from creature to creature.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.high-elf.sign.zh: 你的魔法魅力會讓人不自覺地被你吸引。由於每個人喜歡的特徵不盡相同，這種魔法魅力會讓你在每個生物眼中呈現出略為不同的外表與聲音。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.high-elf.trai.en: Whenever you take damage from a creature, you can use a triggered action to make that creature frightened of you until the end of their next turn.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.high-elf.trai.zh: 每當你受到生物造成的傷害時，你可以使用反應動作讓該生物對你陷入畏縮狀態，直到他下個回合結束。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.high-elf.trai.en: Your mind allows you to maintain your focus in any situation.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.high-elf.trai.zh: 你的心智能讓你在任何情況下保持專注。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.human.signatu.en: Until the end of your next turn, you know the location of any supernatural object, undead, construct, or creature from another world within 5 squares, even if you don’t have line of effect to that object or creature. You know if you’re detecting an item or a creature, and you know the nature of any creature you detect.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.human.signatu.zh: 直到你下個回合結束前，你知道 5 格內任何超常物體、亡靈、構裝體或異界生物的位置，即使你對他們沒有效果線也能如此。你能分辨偵測到的是物體還是生物，並且能知道那些生物的本質。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.human.trait.d.en: A tolerance for pain and distress allows you to push through difficult situations.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.human.trait.d.zh: 你可以忍受痛苦和壓力，在困境中堅持前行。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.human.trait.p.en: When you are slowed, your speed is reduced to 3 instead of 2.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.human.trait.p.zh: 若你處於緩速狀態，你的速度會降至 3，而非 2。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.human.trait.r.en: Your instinctive resilience protects you from injuries beyond the routine.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.human.trait.r.zh: 你與生俱來的韌性會保護你免受異常傷害。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.human.trait.s.en: Your human physiology allows you to fight, run, and stay awake longer than others.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.human.trait.s.zh: 人類的生理構造能讓你比其他族群更持久地戰鬥、奔跑和保持清醒。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.en: Your connection to Axiom, the plane of Uttermost Law, allows you to manage chaos around you.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.zh: 你與「至律位面」公理界的連結能讓你控制周圍的混亂。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.en: You can push your body to move at incredible speeds. Your Speed is 7.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.zh: 你的身體可以達到驚人的移動速度。你的速度為 7。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.en: Your connection to Axiom allows you to regulate your movement.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.zh: 你與公理界的連結能讓你調節自身的移動力。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.en: You treat any language you don’t know as if you know a related language.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.zh: 對於任何你不懂的語言，你都視為懂得某種與之相關的語言。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.en: Velloparatha - the worldsickness - might hinder, but you know how to turn your pain into something your enemies feel.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.zh: 維洛帕拉症（俗稱躍界病）或許會妨礙你，但你也知道如何將自己的痛苦轉化為敵人能夠感受到的力量。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.orc.trait.gro.en: The magic in your blood makes it difficult for others to move you.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.orc.trait.gro.zh: 你血液中的魔力讓他人難以移動你。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.orc.trait.non.en: Your bloodfire supplies you with a constant rush of adrenaline.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.orc.trait.non.zh: 你的血焰讓你的腎上腺素持續翻湧。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.polder.signat.en:
You flatten yourself into a shadow against a wall or floor you are touching, and become hidden from any creature you have cover or concealment from or who isn’t observing you. While in shadow form, you have full awareness of your surroundings, and strikes against you and tests made to search for you take a bane. You can’t move or be force moved, and you can’t take main actions or maneuvers except to exit this form or to direct creates under your control, such as one you summon using an ability. Any ability or effect that targets more than 1 square affects you in this form only if it explicitly affects the surface you are flattened against. You can exit this form as a maneuver.

If the surface you are flattened against is destroyed, this ability ends and you take 1d6 damage that can’t be reduced in any way.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.polder.signat.zh:
你將自己化為平貼於牆面或地面的影子。此時，若你對 1 個生物具有掩護或遮蔽，或該生物觀察不到你，你就會對他處於隱藏。在影子形態中，你能完全感知周遭的環境，而且對你發動的任何打擊和搜索考驗都會承受 1 個劣勢。你無法移動或被強制移動，也無法執行主要動作和機動動作（除了脫離此形態或指揮受你控制的生物，例如你發動招式召喚的生物）。影響多格的招式或效果，只有在明確影響你所貼附的表面時，你才會受到影響。你可以使用機動動作脫離此形態。

若你所貼附的表面被摧毀，此招式會立刻終止，而且你會受到 1d6 點傷害（無法以任何方式減免）。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.polder.signat.en: Your diminutive stature lets you easily get out of — or into — trouble.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.polder.signat.zh: 你嬌小的身材能讓你更輕易地擺脫（或陷入）麻煩。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.polder.trait..en: Your small size makes it easier for you to slip away from the fray.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.polder.trait..zh: 你矮小的體型能讓你更容易從混戰中溜走。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.polder.trait..en: Staying light on your feet lets you quickly get back into position.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.polder.trait..zh: 保持輕盈的步伐能讓你快速回到有利位置。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.revenant.desc.en: The dead walk among us. Some of them are happier about it than others. Unlike the necromantic rituals that produce wights and wraiths and zombies, revenants rise from the grave through a combination of an unjust death and a burning desire for vengeance. Creatures sustained on pure will, they have no need of food or water or air - and, unlike their zombified cousins, they retain all their memories and personality from life.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.revenant.desc.zh: 死者行走在我們之間，但不是所有死者都樂於接受這種情況。不同於製造屍妖、怨靈和殭屍的死靈儀式，還魂屍是因為枉死與強烈的復仇心而從墳墓中爬出來。他們之所以能夠存在於世上，不是依靠食物、水或空氣，而是純粹的意志力。與殭屍不同的是，還魂屍保留了生前的所有記憶和個性。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.revenant.sign.en: When your Stamina reaches the negative of your winded value, you become inert instead of dying. You fall prone and can’t stand. You continue to observe your surroundings, but you can’t speak, take main actions, maneuvers, move actions, or triggered actions. While inert this way, if you take any fire damage, your body is destroyed and you die. Otherwise, after 12 hours, you regain Stamina equal to your recovery value.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.revenant.sign.zh: 當你的體力降至疲態值的負數時，你會陷入呆滯，而非死亡。你會伏地且無法起身。你能繼續觀察周圍環境，但無法說話，也無法執行主要動作、機動動作、移動動作和反應動作。在這種呆滯狀態下，若你受到任何火焰傷害，你的軀體就會被摧毀，你也會真正死亡。否則，在 12 小時後，你會恢復等於你復元值的體力。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.revenant.trai.en: For you, an open wound is indistinguishable from a scratch.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.revenant.trai.zh: 對你而言，開放性傷口與輕微擦傷沒有區別。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.revenant.trai.en:
As a maneuver, you place a magic sigil on a creature within 10 squares of you. When you place a sigil, you can decide where it appears on the creature’s body, and whether the sigil is visible to only you or to all creatures.

You always know the direction to the exact location of a creature who bears one of your sigils and is on the same world. You can have an active number of sigils equal to your level, and can remove a sigil from a creature at will (no action required). If you already have the maximum number of sigils activated and you place a new one, your oldest sigil disappears with no other effect.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.revenant.trai.zh:
使用機動動作，你可以在 10 格內的 1 個生物身上放置 1 個魔法符印。放置符印時，你可以決定符印出現在生物身體的哪個位置，以及符印是只有你看得見，還是所有生物都看得見。

你始終知道相同世界中帶有你符印之生物的位置方向。你最多可以擁有數量等於你等級的符印，並且可以隨意解除生物身上的符印（無需動作）。若你在符印數量已滿的情況下放置新的符印，最舊的符印就會消失，不會產生任何效果。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.time-raider.t.en: You automatically know the location of any creature with concealment who isn’t hidden from you within 20, and you negate the usual bane on strikes against such creatures.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.time-raider.t.zh: 你會自動知道 20 格內任何對你具有遮蔽但並未處於隱藏的生物位置，而且當你對這些生物發動打擊時，你會無視通常需要承受的 1 個劣勢。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.time-raider.t.en: Your mind allows you to maintain your focus in any situation.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.time-raider.t.zh: 你的心智能讓你在任何情況下保持專注。

fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.sign.en: Tests made to search for you while you are hidden take a bane.
fs-adapt:heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.sign.zh: 當你處於隱藏時，其他生物試圖搜索你的考驗都會承受 1 個劣勢。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.agent..en: While on a dangerous espionage assignment, things went sideways. Although you escaped with your life, the mission was a public failure thanks to bad information your agency gave you. They denied you work for them, and you went on the run. Hero work will let you survive and clear your name.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.agent..zh: 在一次危險的間諜任務中，事情出了差錯。你雖然保住了性命，但由於機構提供的情報有誤，任務的失敗也公諸於世。機構否認你曾為他們工作，迫使你開始逃亡。成為英雄不僅能讓你維持生計，還能幫你洗清名譽。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.agent..en: Your identity was always hidden. It was your way of protecting those around you because the work you did spying on powerful entities came with dangers. Then your world came crashing down when an enemy agent unmasked you, causing you to lose everything - your privacy, livelihood, loved ones, all gone in the blink of an eye. Instead of going into hiding, you became a public hero to protect the innocent in the name of those you lost.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.agent..zh: 監視大人物的工作充滿危險，你始終隱藏自己的身分，這是你保護親朋好友的方式。但一名敵方特務揭穿了你的身分，你的世界就此崩塌，你的隱私、生計、摯愛，一瞬間全都消失了。面對這樣的打擊，你沒有選擇躲藏，而是成為一名公開的英雄，以逝者之名保護無辜者。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.agent..en: There was a time in your life when you used to sell information to the highest bidder. Your acts were unsanctioned by any one organization, but you were well-connected enough to trade in secrets. Politics never mattered much to you until the information you sold wound up causing a ripple effect of harm that eventually destroyed the place you once called home. You became a hero to make up for your past.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.agent..zh: 你曾經將情報賣給出價最高的買家。你不隸屬於任何組織，但憑藉廣闊的人脈進行情報交易。政治曾對你毫無意義，直到你販賣的情報引發了連鎖反應，最終摧毀你視為家園的地方。你成為英雄，就是為了彌補過去的錯誤。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.agent..en: After years of cultivating a rich list of informants, one of those informants risked everything to expose the heinous plans of powerful individuals. You promised to protect your informant, but your agency left them hanging - literally. You cut ties with your employer and swore to always make good on your word as a hero.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.agent..zh: 在多年培養大量的線人名單後，其中一位冒著生命危險揭露了權貴的邪惡計畫。你承諾保護這位線人，但你的機構卻背棄了他，任由他被吊死。你因此與雇主徹底斷絕關係，並立誓成為一名英雄，永遠信守自己的承諾。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.agent..en: While embedded in an undercover assignment, you fell for someone on the other side. They discovered you were a double-agent and though you insisted your feelings were real, the deceit cut too deep for your love interest to ignore. They exposed you, spurned you, or died because of their closeness to you. You left the espionage business to become a hero with nothing to hide.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.agent..zh: 在執行臥底任務時，你愛上了對方陣營的某人。當他發現你是雙重間諜時，即使你真誠地表明自己的真實感情，但這種欺騙對你的愛人來說傷害太深，無法被原諒。他可能因此揭發了你的身分、拒絕你的愛，或因為你的關係而喪命。這段經歷讓你決定離開間諜事業，轉而成為一名不再需要隱藏真實自我的英雄。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.agent..en: You spent your life in service of your country or an organization that upheld your values. During your undercover operations, you discovered everything you were told was a lie. Whether you confronted your superiors or were exposed, you were stripped of your service medals before you left to become a true hero.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.agent..zh: 你畢生都為祖國或與你價值觀相符的組織服務。在執行臥底任務期間，你發現你所知的一切都是謊言。無論你是質問上級，還是身分曝光，在你離開並成為真正的英雄之前，你的功勳獎章全都被剝奪了。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.aristo.en: When you entered adulthood, you heard unsavory whispers about your family’s fortune before learning that their wealth came at the cost of others’ suffering. Whether you shed light on the secret or not, you left to become a hero stripped of noble title.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.aristo.zh: 在你成年後，你聽聞關於家族財富的不光彩傳言，後來發現這些財富確實建立在他人的痛苦之上。不管你是否選擇揭露這個祕密，你最終都離開了家族，成為一位失去貴族頭銜的英雄。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.aristo.en: Through some treasure or innate ability, you were able to defraud other aristocrats. You did it for fun. When you were found out, you lost your status. Whether you served time or escaped from punishment, you decided to rehabilitate yourself and became a hero.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.aristo.zh: 無論是藉由超自然力量還是天生的說服技巧，你成功欺騙了其他貴族，而且你是純粹為了樂趣而這麼做。當行為敗露後，你喪失了貴族身分。不管最終是服刑還是逃過懲罰，你決定洗心革面，成為一位英雄。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.aristo.en: The guardians who instilled in you the virtues of doing the right thing were murdered in a senseless petty robbery. Though their wealth was bequeathed to you, it did little to assuage the guilt you felt for being unable to stop the deadly crime. You decided to use your riches to fund your life as a hero, whether publicly or using an alter ego.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.aristo.zh: 那些曾教導你正義美德的監護人，在一場無意義的小型搶劫中遭到殺害。雖然你繼承了他們的財富，但這完全無法減輕你因為無力阻止那場悲劇而感到的愧疚。你決定用這筆財富資助自己成為英雄，無論是以真實身分公開行動，還是以另一個身分隱藏行蹤。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.aristo.en: Life outside the manor never piqued your interest. You had everything you wanted. It came as a surprise when the peasants came to overthrow your family. You narrowly escaped, and for the first time witnessed the world. It caused you to become a hero for the people, fighting against inequities.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.aristo.zh: 莊園外的生活從未吸引過你，你擁有一切想要的東西，生活無憂無慮。所以，當農民突然前來推翻你的家族時，你感到無比震驚。僥倖逃脫後，你首次看見了外面的世界。這次經歷徹底改變了你，讓你決定成為為人民而戰的英雄，致力對抗社會的不平等。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.aristo.en: Seeking a break from noble duties, you sought a lookalike to switch identities with. It went so well that you made a habit of switching whenever bored. Unfortunately, your counterpart became so good at imitating you that they convinced everyone you were an impostor. You lost contact with your family, but pursue a heroic path free of the pomp of your old life.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.aristo.zh: 你厭倦了貴族的職責，找到一位外貌相似的人交換身分。此舉效果極佳，你甚至養成了在無聊時就互換身分的習慣。不幸的是，替身的模仿技巧過於精湛，最終說服了所有人你才是冒牌貨。雖然與家人失去了聯繫，但你如今擺脫了過往生活的虛華，自由地追尋英雄之路。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.aristo.en: One parent passed away when you were a baby and the other remarried years later. Then that parent died under suspicious circumstances. Their spouse ousted you, and you were banished (and possibly hunted). Rising from tragedy, you now seek to right the wrongs of the world.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.aristo.zh: 你父母的其中一位在你嬰兒時期就去世了，另一位則在多年後再婚。隨後，那位生父（母）在可疑的情況下死亡。繼父（母）將你趕出家門（甚至追殺你）。你從這場悲劇中崛起，如今致力於糾正世界的不公。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.artisa.en: A great hero was a fan of the things you created, and gave you a generous commission to create your best work for them. While working on this commission, you and the hero became close friends. The day you finished the work was the same day they disappeared. To honor their legacy, you took up the mantle of a hero with the intent of finishing your friend’s work.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.artisa.zh: 一位偉大的英雄十分欣賞你的作品，並慷慨委託你為他打造最精湛的傑作。在製作過程中，你們建立了深厚的友誼。然而，就在你完成作品的那天，這位英雄突然消失了。為了紀念他的遺志，你決定披上英雄的斗篷，完成你朋友未竟的志業。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.artisa.en: As you traveled the road selling your wares, troll bandits attacked you. One of the bandits claimed an item belonging to someone precious to you - or perhaps claimed that person’s life - but the rest were driven off or slain by a group of heroes. Seeing the quick work these heroes made of the bandits inspired you to follow in their footsteps.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.artisa.zh: 當你在路上販售商品時，遭到醜魔盜匪襲擊。一名盜匪搶走了你珍視之人的物品（甚至奪取了那人的性命）。幸好，其餘盜匪被一群英雄擊退或擊斃。目睹這些英雄俐落地解決了盜匪，你深受鼓舞，決心追隨他們的腳步。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.artisa.en: A criminal gang stole your goods and harmed a number of people who worked for you. You became a hero to prevent such indignities from being visited upon others, to seek revenge for the assault, or to find the thieves and get your stuff back.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.artisa.zh: 一夥犯罪團夥偷走了你的貨物，並傷害了許多為你工作的人。你決心成為英雄，可能是為了防止他人遭受相同的不幸、對這次襲擊展開復仇，或是找回被盜的物品。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.artisa.en: Your parents discouraged your artistic talents, instead trying to focus your passions on the family business. You refused to dim your spark and continued your work in secret. Enraged at discovering your disobedience, they sold your work to a traveling merchant. You left your hometown, seeking your lost art and encouraging others to live freely.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.artisa.zh: 你的父母不支持你的藝術天賦，而是試圖讓你承接家族事業。你拒絕讓自己的創意之火熄滅，繼續在暗地裡創作。他們發現後勃然大怒，將你的作品賣給了一位旅行商人。你因此離開了家鄉，踏上尋回失落作品的旅程，同時鼓勵他人追求自由的生活。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.artisa.en: A new patron commissioned some art, but on completion, they refused to pay you and claimed the work as their own. You were accused of plagiarism and run out of town. For you, heroics are about restoring your name and honor.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.artisa.zh: 一位新贊助人委託你製作藝術品，但作品完成後，對方卻拒絕付款，並聲稱這是他們自己的創作。你被誣告抄襲，被迫離開城鎮。對你來說，成為英雄就是為了重建自己的名譽。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.artisa.en: You had great success that caused an unscrupulous rival to curse you. For a time, everything you tried to create turned to ruin. You broke the curse through adventuring, and in doing so discovered a new joy and purpose that now defines you.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.artisa.zh: 你曾取得巨大的成功，卻引來了一位無良對手的詛咒。在一段時間內，你創作的每件作品都變成垃圾。透過冒險旅程，你成功打破詛咒，並在這過程中發現新的喜悅與人生目標，而這些如今已成為你生命的核心。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.beggar.en: You were never content with your lot. Watching yet another friend fall to preventable circumstances was your last straw. You gathered up what little you had and set off to become a hero, determined to make real change for those society forgot.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.beggar.zh: 你從來都不安於現狀。看著又一位朋友因為本可避免的情況而倒下，這成了壓垮你的最後一根稻草。你收拾僅有的一點家當，踏上成為英雄的旅程，決心為那些被社會遺忘的人們帶來真正的改變。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.beggar.en: Something killed the other beggars. It came in the night. You barely saw it, but what you did see of it wasn’t natural. You survived by hiding, or perhaps it simply passed you over for reasons unknown to you. It still haunts your nightmares, and you kill monsters so no one else has to experience such horrors.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.beggar.zh: 某種東西在夜裡出現並殺死了其他乞丐。你幾乎沒見過它的真面目，但你知道它絕非自然之物。你靠躲藏活了下來，又或者它因為某個你不知道的原因而放過了你。那段恐怖經歷至今仍糾纏著你的夢境，所以你開始獵殺怪物，不讓他人經歷相同的恐怖。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.beggar.en: You ran afoul of the local watch by being in the wrong place when they were in a bad mood. A passing hero intervened on your behalf, shaming the guards into moving on, then gave you enough gold to get you back on your feet. Their kindness kindled a spark in you. You took the gold, bought some secondhand gear, and went to pay that hero’s kindness forward.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.beggar.zh: 你在錯誤的時間出現在錯誤的地點，惹上了心情不好的當地警衛。一位路過的英雄挺身而出，讓那些警衛羞愧離開，並給了你足夠的金幣重新站起來。這份善良在你心中點燃了一絲火花，你拿著金幣買了些二手裝備，開始將那位英雄的善意傳遞下去。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.beggar.en: No matter how far you’d fallen, there was one belonging you would never part with, no matter how much money it would bring you. When a pickpocket stole it, you chased them until you were in a part of the city you no longer recognized. With a jolt, you realized you had no desire to return to your previous stomping grounds. You kept going, and you haven’t looked back.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.beggar.zh: 無論你窮困潦倒至何種境地，總有一件物品是你絕不願放棄的，不管它能換來多少金錢。所以，當一名扒手偷走了那件寶物，你一路追趕，來到了陌生的城市角落。突然間，你意識到自己不想再回到過去那個熟悉的地方。就這樣，你繼續前行，再也沒有回頭。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.beggar.en: A passerby dropped something in your cup. When you counted your day’s collections, you found a magic coin among the coppers. You knew immediately that it was special. When the other beggars - your friends, you thought - were ready to murder you for it, you killed several of them in self- defense before you fled, leaving behind the only semblance of community you had.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.beggar.zh: 一位路人往你的杯子扔了一些東西。當你清點當天的收入時，在一堆銅幣中發現了一枚魔法硬幣，你立刻感覺到它非比尋常。當其他乞丐（那些你曾視為朋友的人）展現出願意為這枚硬幣殺死你的意圖時，你被迫自衛，殺了其中幾人，然後逃離你唯一能感到歸屬感的社區。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.beggar.en: You saw something you weren’t meant to see. Others would kill you if they knew, and they might be searching for you even now. You remain on the move, terrified of remaining in one place too long lest it all catch up to you. Perhaps if you make a big enough name for yourself, you can become untouchable and can finally speak of what you saw without fear.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.beggar.zh: 你無意中目睹了不該看到的事情。若有人知道你看到什麼，他們會殺你滅口，而且現在可能正在追查你。你被迫不斷移動，擔心在一處停留太久會被追上。也許，如果你能為自己累積足夠響亮的名聲，你就能成為無人敢動的大人物，最終無所畏懼地揭露真相。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.crimin.en: You stole, smuggled, and sold antiquities. In your haste to make a quick sale, you didn’t fully vet a client and they subsequently robbed your warehouse. When the items you had stolen were taken from you, you realized the harm you had caused. Now you adventure to find those items you lost and return them where they belong.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.crimin.zh: 你曾偷竊、走私和販賣古董。在急於成交的情況下，你沒有徹底檢查某位客戶，結果他們洗劫了你的倉庫。當那些被你偷來的物品被奪走時，你終於意識到自己造成的傷害。為了找到那些寶物並將它們歸還原處，你踏上了冒險之路。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.crimin.en: The last criminal job you pulled led to the death of someone or the destruction of something you love. To make up for the loss you caused, you left your criminal ways behind and became a hero.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.crimin.zh: 你最後一次的犯罪行動導致某人死亡或毀掉你的珍愛之物。為了彌補這個損失，你放棄了犯罪生活，轉而成為英雄。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.crimin.en: You went to prison for your crimes and eventually escaped. An elderly priest took you in and shielded you from the law, convinced that your soul wasn’t corrupt. They never judged you for your past, speaking only of the future. Eventually, the priest died, imparting final words that inspired you to become a hero.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.crimin.zh: 你因罪入獄，最終逃脫。一位年邁的祭司收留了你，並保護你免受法律追捕，因為他深信你的靈魂未被腐化。他從來都不會因為你的過去評判你，只談論未來。最終，祭司去世，他的臨終遺言激勵了你成為一名英雄。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.crimin.en: You spent years blackmailing and manipulating nobles for influence and wealth until a scheme went wrong. You were publicly exposed, and after a narrow escape, you reevaluated your life. Under a new identity, you work as a hero and hope no one looks at your past too closely.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.crimin.zh: 你曾花了數年時間勒索和操控貴族，獲取權勢與財富，直到一個計畫出了差錯。你的所作所為遭到公開揭露，在驚險逃脫後，你重新審視了自己的人生。現在，你以新的身分成為英雄，希望沒人會仔細追查你的過去。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.crimin.en: Stealing was a matter of survival for you and not what defined you - at least in your mind. But when your thieving actions lead to innocent folk being harmed, you knew you could be better. You turned your back on your old life, though your old skills come in handy.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.crimin.zh: 對你而言，偷竊只是生存手段，而非你的本質（至少在你心目中是如此）。然而，當你的竊盜行為傷害了無辜之人時，你很清楚自己能夠做得更好。你最終背棄了過去的生活，但你的舊技能仍然可以派上用場。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.crimin.en: When a tyrant rose to power in your homeland, they began cracking down on all criminals with deadly raids and public executions. The nature of the crime didn’t matter - pickpockets and beggars were made to kneel before the axe alongside murderers. After losing enough friends, you stood up and joined the resistance - not just against this tyrant, but against authoritarians anywhere.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.crimin.zh: 當暴君在你的祖國掌權時，他開始以致命突襲和公開處決鎮壓所有罪犯。罪行輕重不再重要，扒手和乞丐與殺人兇手一樣被迫在斧頭前跪下。在失去太多朋友後，你挺身而出，加入了抵抗行動。你不只反抗這個暴君，更要對抗世界各地的獨裁者。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.discip.en: Swayed by an evil faith, your cult was about to unleash horrors upon the world when an angel (figurative or literal) intervened. They convinced you to stop your cult’s efforts. Now you follow in the footsteps of the angel who showed you the righteous path.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.discip.zh: 當你的教派被邪惡信仰誘惑，準備向世界釋放恐怖之物時，一位天使介入了（無論是比喻或實際的），並說服你阻止了邪教的陰謀。如今，你追隨著那位天使的腳步，走在正義的道路上。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.discip.en: Although you joined the religious institution under the guidance of a kind mentor, others within the house of worship became increasingly fanatical in their convictions. Your mentor sought to be a voice of reason in the rising tide of hatred and was tried as a heretic before being executed. Leaving the institution behind, you became a hero to uphold the beliefs you hold dear.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.discip.zh: 你在一位善良導師的指引下加入了宗教機構，但隨著時間推移，教派內其他成員的信念變得越來越狂熱。當仇恨情緒日益高漲時，你的導師試圖以理性之聲勸說眾人，卻以異端罪名受審，隨後遭到處決。離開這個機構後，你成為了一名英雄，繼續堅守著你所珍視的信念。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.discip.en: Your temple was destroyed in a religious conflict. The institution’s leaders sought retaliation, but you saw in these actions a ceaseless cycle of destruction that would lead to more conflict. Instead, you became a hero to protect religious freedoms, so all worshipers could practice their faith without fear.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.discip.zh: 你的神殿在一場宗教衝突中被摧毀。機構的領導者尋求報復，但你意識到這只會導致無盡的惡性循環，引發更多衝突。因此，你成為了英雄，致力保護宗教自由，讓所有信徒能夠無懼地實踐自己的信仰。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.discip.en: You devoted your life to ministering to the sick and needy and other charitable work. Time and time again, tragedy struck those you served without rhyme or reason. Your prayers went unanswered, and your efforts went thankless. Eventually, you lost your faith in a higher power, and you left your church or temple to do good outside of any religious affiliation.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.discip.zh: 你曾獻身於照料病患和窮人，並從事各種慈善工作。然而，災難卻一次又一次毫無理由地降臨在你服務的人們身上。你的祈禱始終無人回應，你的付出也從未獲得任何感謝。最終，你對神明的信仰逐漸消逝，於是離開了教會或神殿，決定在宗教組織之外繼續行善。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.discip.en: While serving at a religious institution, you almost died in an accident. When you woke, you had lost all memory of ever having worked for the church or temple. Though the clergy encouraged you to stay, you left to forge a new path. Your sense of altruism - whether instilled in you by your past work or a part of who you naturally are - guides you in your life.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.discip.zh: 在宗教機構服務期間，你因為一場意外而幾乎喪命。醒來後，你完全忘記曾在教會或神殿工作的記憶。儘管神職人員勸你留下，你還是選擇離開，開創新的人生道路。然而，你的奉獻精神（無論是源自過去的工作，還是你與生俱來的本性）如今依然指引著你的生活。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.discip.en: The faith-based organization you were once part of became corrupt. It used its status in the community to accumulate wealth through tithes and its leaders sought political appointments. During a season of drought, the institution stockpiled resources and refused to give aid, resulting in the deaths of many. You became a hero to fight against such corruption and to honor your dearly departed.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.discip.zh: 你曾經效力的宗教組織已經腐敗。領導者濫用自己在社區中的地位，透過收取什一奉獻來累積財富，積極謀求政治職位。在某次乾旱期間，該組織顧著囤積資源並拒絕提供援助，導致多人喪生。你挺身成為英雄，對抗這種腐敗之舉，並紀念那些逝去的生命。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.explor.en: In an uncharted area, you awakened some dark horror. You have turned to the life of a hero to put an end to the horror you unleashed and keep other hidden dangers at bay.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.explor.zh: 在一處未知區域，你意外喚醒了某種可怕的存在。此後，你踏上了英雄的道路，致力於終結你所釋放的恐怖，同時防範其他潛藏的危險。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.explor.en: You made an important but dangerous discovery about a treasure or ancient ritual that could spell mass destruction. Then the unthinkable happened when an unscrupulous colleague, spy, or treasure hunter stole your research notes. You’re looking for them now, and anyone else who might use such discoveries for ill.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.explor.zh: 你發現了一個關於寶藏或古老儀式的重要線索，但這項發現十分危險，甚至可能引發大規模毀滅。然後，難以想像的事情發生了。一位不道德的同事、間諜或尋寶獵人偷走了你的研究筆記。現在你正在追尋這個竊賊，以及任何可能濫用這項發現的人。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.explor.en: Traversing seas and mountains to collect valuable artifacts for cultural institutions was once your way of life. When people died trying to reclaim one of the objects you took, you realized the truth. Your work was part of a larger problem of misappropriation and the best place for these significant objects wasn’t in a museum but with the people who created them. You set out to return what had been taken and to protect others from theft.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.explor.zh: 探索遙遠土地，並為文化機構收集珍貴文物曾是你的生活方式。然而，當人們為了奪回你帶走的一件物品而犧牲生命時，你領悟了真相，你的工作實際上是文化掠奪的一部分。這些重要物品的最佳歸屬並非博物館，而是創造它們的人民。你決心歸還被奪走之物，並保護他人免受竊盜，這段旅程引領你成為了一名英雄。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.explor.en: You delved into dungeons and far-off places by studying them in books. You were an explorer who never felt the need to experience the dangers your peers did. However, your theory about a lost world cost you your reputation. It gave you the impetus to go on adventures and stand up for those with different ideas.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.explor.zh: 你只透過書本來研究地下城和遠方世界。作為一名探險家，你從來都不認為自己需要像同儕那樣親身體驗各種危險。然而，你提出的失落世界理論最終讓你聲譽掃地，但同時也給了你動力，促使你踏上真正的冒險之旅，並為那些抱持不同觀點的人挺身而出。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.explor.en: You saw yourself as an observer and operated within a code of conduct. You swore to never interfere with a group by exposing them to your technology, knowledge, or values. When faced with a moral conundrum, you either broke your code or stood idly by - and suffered the consequences. During this incident, you lost your observation journal but became a hero who refuses to let evil stand unchecked.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.explor.zh: 你將自己視為一名觀察者，嚴格遵循行為準則。你發誓絕不會展示自己的技術、知識或價值觀來干擾任何群體。然而，當面臨道德困境時，你要麼打破自己的原則，要麼袖手旁觀，而無論選擇哪一條路，都得承擔後果。在此事件中，你雖然失去了珍貴的觀察日誌，卻成為了一位堅決對抗邪惡的英雄。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.explor.en: As a seafaring explorer, you lived to chart unknown courses. Though travel on the high seas was fraught with danger, the destination was always rewarding in riches, knowledge, or some other way that was meaningful to you. Your luck ran out when your ship was destroyed by pirates or other enemy forces. You’ve taken to protecting those who seek safe passage while also hoping to avenge your crew.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.explor.zh: 作為一名航海探險家，你活著就是為了繪製未知的航線。雖然公海航行充滿危險，但每個目的地都能帶來財富、知識或其他寶貴的收穫。不幸的是，當你的船被海盜或敵對勢力摧毀時，你的好運到此為止。如今，你不僅致力於保護尋求安全通行的人們，同時也希望為你的船員復仇。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.farmer.en: A horrible blight swept over your homeland, sickening the livestock and causing crops to rot. No one knows whether the blight is of natural origin or something more malevolent, but you set out in search of a way to cleanse the land of this affliction.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.farmer.zh: 一場可怕的疾病席捲你的家鄉，導致牲畜染病，農作物腐爛。沒有人知道這場瘟疫是自然現象，還是某種更為惡毒的東西，但你已經踏上旅程，尋找淨化這片土地的方法。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.farmer.en: You’ve always wanted so much more than gathering eggs and milking cows. You kept a secret journal of your dreams, filled with all the things you wanted. When your parent found the journal, they burned it and told you to keep your head out of the clouds. In response, you gathered what you could in a pack and left everything else behind, seeking a life of adventure.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.farmer.zh: 你渴望的生活遠遠不只是收集雞蛋和擠牛奶。你偷偷寫了一本夢想日記，記錄著所有你嚮往的事物。當父親或母親發現這本日記時，便將它付之一炬，並告訴你別做白日夢。於是，你收拾了能帶走的物品，拋下了其他的一切，踏上追尋冒險生活的旅程。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.farmer.en: While tilling your fields, you found something in the dirt. Perhaps it was a chipped and dented weapon, a piece of ancient jewelry, or something altogether unique. Excited by your find, you showed it to a loved one, but when they touched it, something happened. You now know it was a curse conveyed by the item, though you don’t know why it affected them and not you. You left your old life in search of answers.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.farmer.zh: 在耕種田地時，你在泥土中發現了某樣東西。也許是一把有缺口又凹陷的武器、一件古老的珠寶，或是某種完全獨特的物品。你興奮地將發現展示給一位你珍視的人，但當對方碰觸它時，意外發生了。如今，你明白那是物品傳遞的詛咒，卻不知為何它影響了對方，而不是你自己。為了尋找答案，你離開了過去的生活。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.farmer.en: Your farm had always been prosperous, until the last few years. Changes in the weather caused smaller yields until you could no longer pay your tithe to the local noble. Her soldiers took what items of value they found, including a precious family heirloom. You left the struggling farm behind to find a better life.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.farmer.zh: 你的農場曾經繁榮興盛，直到近年情況急轉直下。氣候變化導致收成逐年減少，最終你無法向當地貴族繳納什一稅。她派來的士兵拿走了能找到的值錢物品，甚至奪走了你珍貴的傳家寶。面對這般窘境，你決定離開經營困難的農場，尋找更好的生活。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.farmer.en: Your animals were killed, your crops and home set ablaze. The culprits might have been wandering bandits, raiders from a nearby kingdom, or hired thugs sent by a rival farm. Whoever they were, they left you with nothing. You couldn’t face the thought of starting again from scratch, so you took up a life of heroism to protect others from such villainy.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.farmer.zh: 你的牲畜慘遭屠殺，農作物與家園被大火吞噬。兇手可能是流浪盜匪、鄰國掠奪者，或競爭農場雇用的打手。無論他們是誰，你已一無所有。你放棄了重新開始的想法，選擇了英雄之路，保護他人免受類似的惡行侵害。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.farmer.en: Your family bred horses - beautiful creatures that few could rival on the track and in the jousting lists. When a local noble arrived with an offer to buy your prized stallion, your father refused. The noble struck him down where he stood and stole the horse. Without that stallion, the renowned bloodline would end. You intend to get them back - and get revenge.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.farmer.zh: 你的家族以飼養馬匹為業，這些俊美的生物在賽道和比武場上幾乎無人能敵。當一位地方貴族前來提議收購你家珍貴的種馬時，你的父親斷然拒絕。那名貴族憤怒地將他當場殺害，並強行奪走那匹種馬。失去這匹種馬，你家族那著名的馬匹血統將會斷絕。你決心奪回馬匹，同時為父親報仇雪恨。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.gladia.en: A local crime lord offered you money to throw your last bout, promising that you’d live through the ordeal and get a cut of all the wagers placed on the match. You upheld your end of the deal - which made the knife in your back after the bout so surprising. You woke in a shallow grave, barely alive, and ready to mete out justice.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.gladia.zh: 一位當地的犯罪頭目給你一筆錢，要你放水輸掉最後一場比賽，承諾你能安然無恙並從所有賭注中分得一杯羹。你履行了承諾，卻在比賽後被人從背後捅了一刀。你從隨便亂挖的墳塚中醒來，奄奄一息，決心要討回公道。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.gladia.en: As you stood victorious on the arena sands, a voice cried out among the cheering. “This violence is just for show. You should be ashamed. There are people who need you - who need your skills!” Why did that voice ring so clear? And why did it sound so familiar? You never saw the face of the person who uttered those words, but they weighed heavy on you. The next day, you fled the arena to begin a hero’s life.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.gladia.zh: 當你以勝利者之姿站在競技場的沙地上時，一個聲音從歡呼聲中響起：「這暴力不過是場表演。你應該感到羞恥！有人需要你，需要你的武藝！」為何那聲音如此清晰？為何它聽起來如此熟悉？你從未見過說那些話的人，但那些話深埋在你的心中。隔天，你逃離了競技場，展開了英雄的生涯。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.gladia.en: As a child, you loved gladiatorial matches, captivated by the fierce displays of showmanship, never giving much thought to how the competitors ended up in the ring. Then your friend was wrongly accused of a crime and sentenced to compete. You went in their place. After viewing what life was like for those forced to fight, you survived your sentence and resolved to protect the unfairly condemned.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.gladia.zh: 小時候，你熱愛角鬥士比賽，被那些勇敢和豪邁的激烈表演所吸引，卻從未思考過參賽者如何走上角鬥場。後來，你的朋友被錯誤指控犯罪並被判處參賽，而你挺身替他上場。在親眼目睹那些戰士被迫戰鬥的生活後，你熬過了刑期，並發誓要保護那些被誣陷判罪的人。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.gladia.en: You earned every title you could. You beat every opponent willing to face you in the arena. Your final battle with your rival ended with you victorious - and still you were unsatisfied. There are other, greater foes out there - and you mean to find them.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.gladia.zh: 你已贏得所有可能獲得的頭銜，打敗了每一位願意在競技場上與你交鋒的對手。與宿敵的最終決戰也以你的勝利告終，然而你依然感到不滿足。你知道外面還有更強大的敵人存在，而你決心要找到他們。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.gladia.en: You were born a noble, but the duplicitous and power-hungry nature of your family had you seeking your own fortune in the arena. You saw that competitors brought there by circumstance and not choice suffered. You gave all you could of your family money to those less fortunate folk and then set out to make a real difference in this cruel world.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.gladia.zh: 你出身貴族，但家族中充滿詭計和權力爭奪，讓你決定在競技場上尋求自己的命運。你目睹那些被迫參賽的人所遭受的痛苦。你將家族財富盡可能地分給這些不幸之人，然後踏上旅程，決心在這個殘酷的世界中創造真正的改變。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.gladia.en: The orphanage you grew up in secretly supplied gladiators to the arena. Forced to fight against many childhood friends as an adult, you vowed to dismantle the arena and free other victims. You became a liberator, dedicating to ending the oppression of others until your dying breath.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.gladia.zh: 你從小住的孤兒院暗中向競技場輸送角鬥士。成年後，你被迫與童年好友在場上廝殺，這段經歷讓你立誓摧毀競技場並解救其他受害者。從此，你成為一名解放者，立志終結他人所受的壓迫，直到生命的最後一刻。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.labore.en: Spending your days cleaning and maintaining the sewers doesn’t make you many friends. But you found friendship among the rats. You fought the monsters that hunted your friends, and which everyone else ignored. After making the sewers safe for the rats, you decided to take your talents to the surface and serve other humanoids who might appreciate your efforts in the same way.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.labore.zh: 在清潔和維護下水道的工作並沒有為你贏得多少朋友，但是你在老鼠群中建立了深刻的友誼。你勇敢對抗那些獵殺你朋友的怪物，儘管其他人對這些怪物視而不見。成功為老鼠們打造安全的下水道環境後，你決定將這份才華帶到地面上，為其他可能同樣感激你付出的類人生物服務。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.labore.en: A disaster, such as a cave-in, wildfire, or tidal wave, hit your crew while you were working. You saved as many as you could, but the ones you couldn’t save weigh heavily on your mind. You took up the life of a hero to save as many people as possible, vowing that what happened to you won’t happen again.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.labore.zh: 你負責帶領的工作隊伍遭遇了一場災難，例如塌方、野火或海嘯。你救了許多人，但不是所有人，那些死者在你心中留下了沉重的負擔。因此，你選擇了英雄的道路，立志拯救更多生命，並發誓不讓這樣的悲劇再次發生。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.labore.en: A noble you worked for admonished you publicly for work done poorly - and more than once. Finally, you’d had enough. You vowed to take up a new path and show this noble you’re far more than what they make you out to be.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.labore.zh: 你服務的貴族曾多次在公開場合指責你的工作表現不佳。最終，你無法再忍受這種羞辱。你決心走上嶄新的道路，向這位貴族證明你的價值遠超過他們的輕視。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.labore.en: You worked with a good friend, and on the job, you would always fantasize about what it would be like to hit the road as adventuring heroes … someday. You didn’t count on your friend falling ill and passing away. Now it’s time to live out that dream for both of you.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.labore.zh: 你和一位好朋友一起工作。在工作期間，你們總是幻想著有朝一日能夠踏上英雄之路。你沒想到的是，朋友會突然病倒並離世。現在，是時候為你們兩人實現那個共同的夢想了。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.labore.en: You kept a lighthouse along the constantly stormy cliffs of your village with your mentor. On a clear and sunny day, your mentor vanished. Finding only a cryptic notebook filled with his musings on the supernatural, you left to find what really what happened. The trail has gone cold for now, and you’re helping others find their loved ones in the meantime.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.labore.zh: 你與你的導師共同守護著村莊懸崖上的燈塔，那裡常年風暴肆虐。在一個難得晴朗的日子，你的導師神祕失蹤了。你只找到一本筆記本，上面記錄著他對超自然現象的思考，所以你決定離開家鄉尋找真相。然而，目前追查導師下落的線索已經中斷，在此期間，你也會幫助其他人尋找失蹤的親友。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.labore.en: You labored silently as an uncaring boss drove those around you into the ground, pushing you to work harder to lessen the burden on your companions. But when the boss pushed too far and killed a friend of yours, you led an uprising against them. That was the start of your adventuring life.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.labore.zh: 你默默忍受著你的工作，而那位冷漠的老闆不斷壓榨你周圍的同事，迫使你更加努力工作來減輕同伴的負擔。當老闆過度施壓導致你的一位朋友喪命時，你最終帶領眾人起身反抗。這起事件成為了你冒險生涯的起點。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.mages-.en: While practicing a spell, your inexperience caused the magic to backfire and your memories were wiped, leaving you with only fragments of who you once were. Determined to recall your past, you now dedicate yourself to helping others, hoping your actions will spark some remembrance or lead you to a way to reverse the magic.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.mages-.zh: 在練習一道法術時，你因為經驗不足而導致魔法反噬，你的記憶被清除，只留下過去自我的片段。你決心找回失去的記憶，現在致力於幫助他人，希望你的行動能喚醒一些回憶，或引導你找到逆轉這魔法的方法。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.mages-.en: As a sign of your status as star pupil, your mentor gifted you a familiar as a magic pet. Another jealous apprentice captured the familiar and slipped away in the night. Haunted by your pet’s absence, you adventure to find your kidnapped friend and prevent others from feeling your loss.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.mages-.zh: 為了表彰你是得意門生，導師送給你一隻魔寵。另一位嫉妒的學徒捕捉了這隻魔寵並在夜裡悄悄溜走。魔寵的失蹤一直令你牽掛，於是你踏上冒險之旅，尋找這位被綁架的朋友，同時努力防止他人經歷你所感受的失落。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.mages-.en: One day you woke up and the mage you worked for was just gone. They didn’t take any of their belongings and there was no sign of any foul play - just the scent of sulfur in their bedchamber. You set out on your heroic journey in the aftermath and have been looking for them ever since.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.mages-.zh: 某天早晨醒來，你發現你的導師消失了。他的所有物品都還在原處，現場也沒有任何遭到加害的跡象，只留下臥室中的硫磺氣味。從那天起，你踏上了英雄之旅，決心找到你失蹤的導師。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.mages-.en: Your attempts at magic have always been unpredictable. A powerful mage promised to help you gain control. During your training, a terrible nightmare caused your body to flare with magic and pull the monster of your nightmare into the waking world. The horror escaped. You left, seeking to vanquish their terrible vileness.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.mages-.zh: 你的魔法一直都很不穩定，而一位強大的法師承諾幫你加強控制能力。在訓練中，一場可怕的惡夢讓你體內的魔法爆發，將惡夢中的怪物釋放到現實世界。這恐怖生物逃脫了，你因此離開，決心尋找並消滅那個邪惡存在。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.mages-.en: While studying magic, you accidentally sent yourself from your original world to this one. Now you’re stranded here, hoping to find ancient texts or powerful magic treasures that might transport you back home. A life of adventure it is!
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.mages-.zh: 在學習魔法時，你意外地將自己從原本的世界傳送到了這個世界。如今你被困在此地，希望找到古老文獻或強大魔法寶物來送你回家。一段冒險的生活就此展開！

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.mages-.en: The mage you worked for was a kindly old soul, but the basic magic they taught you always seemed like a small part of something bigger. It wasn’t until you met an adventuring elementalist that you realized hitting the road as a hero was the only way to truly improve and hone your skills. You resigned your apprenticeship and found yourself walking the path of a hero the next day.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.mages-.zh: 你曾經的導師是位和藹可親的老人，但他教給你的基礎魔法似乎始終只是某種更宏大奧祕的一小部分。直到有一天，你遇見了一位正在旅行的元素師，那時你才明白：只有踏上英雄之路，才能真正提升和磨練你的能力。於是你辭去學徒身分，隔天就踏上了成為英雄的旅程。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.perfor.en: You can sing, act, or dance well enough that people actually pay to see you do it. Imagine that!
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.perfor.zh: 你擁有出色的歌唱、演戲或舞蹈技巧，讓人們願意為了觀賞你的表演而付錢。真不錯！

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.perfor.en: During a performance, you watched in horror as the audience was suddenly overcome by a curse that caused them to disintegrate before your eyes. You aren’t sure what happened, but seeking an answer quickly led you to places where only heroes dare to go.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.perfor.zh: 在一場表演中，你驚恐地目睹觀眾突然被詛咒侵襲，在你眼前逐漸分崩離析。你不清楚究竟發生了什麼事，但為了尋找答案，你願意冒險前往只有英雄才敢踏足的地方。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.perfor.en: After a poor performance, you found a script to a well-written play left in your dressing room. The accompanying note asked that if you performed the play, you should give the author credit. But after a commanding performance, you claimed to be star and playwright both - and the curse hidden on those pages activated. A small portion of your skin has begun to transform into undead flesh, and the only cure is to prove you have become selfless.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.perfor.zh: 在一場表現不佳的演出後，你在更衣室發現了一份精彩的劇本。附帶的便條紙要求你，如果要演出這齣戲，就必須註明原作者。然而，在一場精彩的演出後，你卻宣稱自己既是主演又是作者，進而觸發隱藏在劇本中的詛咒。你有一小塊皮膚開始變成不死生物的皮肉，唯一的解藥就是證明你已經學會無私二字。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.perfor.en: You thought you were famous - then that hero came to your show. Suddenly, all eyes were on the dragon-slaying brute instead of on the stage where they belonged. The audience even gave them a standing ovation when they entered the room. All you got was polite applause. Fine. If people want a hero so much, then a hero you shall be.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.perfor.zh: 你曾以為自己很出名，直到那位英雄出現在你的表演中。突然間，所有目光都轉向那位屠龍莽漢，而非該受關注的舞台。觀眾甚至在他進場時起立歡呼，而你只獲得了禮貌性的掌聲。好吧，既然人們如此渴望英雄，那麼你決定要成為一位真正的英雄。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.perfor.en: Your performances have always been tinged with a bit of melancholy. During a particularly soulful performance, spirits disturbed the living audience and sat in their chairs. They begged you to prevent their demise, providing no other details before disappearing. You set out to see if you could help your most dedicated fans.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.perfor.zh: 你的表演總是帶有一絲憂傷。在一場特別動人的演出中，幽靈擾亂了現場觀眾，並占據他們的座位。這些幽靈懇求你阻止他們的死亡，卻沒留下任何其他線索就消失了。你決定踏上旅程，希望能幫助這些最忠實的粉絲。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.perfor.en: A heckler’s mocking words left you utterly speechless during a performance, stinging your pride and stirring your arrogance. The incident strained your legendary voice, and you could only speak in soft whispers. The heckler was a fey trickster who stole your voice, promising to give it back after you accomplished real good in the world.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.perfor.zh: 在一場表演中，一位鬧場者的冷嘲熱諷讓你完全說不出話來，刺痛你的自尊並激起你的傲慢。這次事件損傷了你那傳奇的嗓音，讓你只能用微弱的氣音說話。原來，那鬧場者是個搗蛋的妖精，偷走了你的聲音，並承諾只有當你完成真正的善行後，才會將聲音歸還給你。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.perfor.en: When a producer who once shortchanged you shouted out on the street for you to stop a thief who had picked their pocket, your spite toward the producer inspired you to let the thief run right on by. But that decision led to tragedy when the thief later harmed someone you loved. From that moment on, you made it your responsibility to protect others.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.perfor.zh: 當一位曾經少付你報酬的製作人在街上大喊，要你攔住剛剛扒竊他的扒手時，你對他的怨恨讓你刻意放任扒手逃跑。然而，這個決定後來釀成悲劇，那個扒手傷害了你所愛的人。從那一刻起，你立志將保護他人視為自己的責任。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.politi.en: Your political power allowed you to be foolish without consequence. Through sheer carelessness or on a dare, you accidentally harmed or killed an innocent bystander. Due to your position as an official, you faced no consequences. But this event was the final straw for the person you loved or respected most, and they turned away from you. You left the world of political machinations behind to earn back their trust.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.politi.zh: 你的政治權力讓你無需承擔魯莽行為的後果。由於一時大意，或是在接受他人的挑戰時，你意外傷害甚至殺死了一名無辜旁觀者。由於你的官方身分，你規避了所有責任。然而，這起事件成為你最愛或最尊敬的人所能容忍的最後一根稻草，他們因此離你而去。你最終選擇離開政治權謀的世界，希望能重新贏得他們的信任。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.politi.en: You secretly funded a rebel organization intent on overthrowing the corrupt establishment. Someone discovered your treason, and you were forced to leave or risk execution. You became a hero to live and fight another day on behalf of those who have no power.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.politi.zh: 你祕密資助了一支意圖推翻腐敗體制的反抗組織。有人發現了你的叛國行為，於是你被迫逃亡，否則就可能面臨處決。為了替那些無權無勢的人奮鬥，你成為了英雄，決心繼續生存並戰鬥下去。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.politi.en: You were seneschal to a leader, able to sway their opinions, but gossip convinced the monarch you were plotting a coup, and you were ousted from court. You became a hero to continue your work making meaningful change in the world.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.politi.zh: 你曾是一位領導者的總管，能夠影響他的決策。然而，流言蜚語讓領導者誤以為你正在策劃政變，你因此被逐出了權力中心。為了繼續在世界上推動有意義的變革，你選擇成為一名英雄。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.politi.en: You tried to work on policy change from the inside of a bureaucratic organization. There were others like you who were more vocal. You started to notice those colleagues were disappearing overnight. Not wanting to find out if you were next on the list, you left to enact change in more direct ways.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.politi.zh: 你曾嘗試從官僚組織內部推動政策變革。有其他人和你持相同立場，但他們的表達更為直接。你漸漸發現這些直言不諱的同事們開始在一夜之間消失。為了避免成為名單上的下一個目標，你決定離開體制，轉而以更直接的方式實現變革。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.politi.en: You used your skills to collect incriminating or scandalous information about your opponents to blackmail them. A rival got one step ahead of you and stole your book of dirty secrets, but instead of using it against you, they gave you an opportunity to leave the world of politics behind. Saved from public humiliation, you now use your skills for the greater good.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.politi.zh: 你曾利用自己的能力收集對手的犯罪或醜聞資訊來進行勒索。一位競爭對手卻搶先一步，偷走你的骯髒祕密檔案。不過，他們並未用這些資訊對付你，而是給了你離開政治舞台的機會。避免被公開羞辱後，你現在將能力用在更崇高的目標。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.politi.en: The red tape required to achieve anything through your political position resulted in a crisis being mishandled and countless people harmed or killed. After that unfortunate event, you resolved to be unfettered by bureaucratic interference and sought to do good through action, not paperwork.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.politi.zh: 你政治職位上的繁文縟節導致了一場處理不當的危機，造成無數人傷亡。在這場悲劇過後，你決心擺脫官僚體制的束縛，選擇透過實際行動而非冗長的文書工作來造福他人。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sage.i.en: You were always content to live a peaceful life in your library, until you found that one book - the one that told the tale of heroes who had saved the timescape. They didn’t spend their days behind a desk. They made a real difference. It was time for you to do the same.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sage.i.zh: 你一直很滿足於在圖書館過著平靜的生活，直到你發現了那本特別的書，一本講述英雄拯救時界的故事。這些英雄不是整天坐在辦公桌後面，而是真正改變了世界。現在，是時候讓你也踏上同樣的旅程了。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sage.i.en: You used to think knowledge could fix everything. You were wrong. When someone you loved fell under a curse, the means to cure them couldn’t be found in any of the books you owned. But that wasn’t going to stop you. The answers are out there, and you’ll find them even if you have to face down death to do so.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sage.i.zh: 你曾以為知識能解決一切，但你錯了。當你心愛的人陷入詛咒時，你所有的書籍都無法提供治癒方法，但這不會阻止你。答案就在外面某處，即使必須面對死亡，你也決心找到它。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sage.i.en: An evil mage took all your books for themself, cackling at your impotence as they raided your shelves. Now, you’re off to search through ancient ruins and secret libraries to rebuild your collection of rare tomes - and to find the mage who stole from you.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sage.i.zh: 一名邪惡的魔導師搶走了你所有的書籍，還嘲笑你的無能為力。如今，你踏上探索古代遺跡和隱密圖書館的旅程，決心重建你珍貴典籍的收藏，同時追尋那個偷書的魔導師。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sage.i.en: While transcribing ancient texts, you and another scribe discovered a shelf of long-forgotten books. At your suggestion, your companion started work on one and vanished along with the tome. Your guilt drove you to seek out your friend and prevent others from falling to similar dangers.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sage.i.zh: 在抄寫古代文獻時，你和另一位抄寫員發現了一整架早已被遺忘的書籍。在你的建議下，你的同伴開始研究其中一本，卻與那本書一同消失了。你的愧疚感驅使你尋找下落不明的朋友，同時致力防止他人遭遇類似的危險。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sage.i.en: In your pursuit of ancient knowledge, you discovered a prophecy that has yet to come to pass. And that prophecy involves someone who might be … you. Since your discovery, strange dreams have plagued you, driving you to seek out your destiny.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sage.i.zh: 在追尋古老知識的過程中，你發現了一個尚未實現的預言。那個預言提到了一個人，而那個人可能就是……你。自從發現這個預言後，奇怪的夢境開始不斷困擾著你，驅使你踏上尋找自己命運的旅程。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sage.i.en: At first you thought it was your imagination, and you brushed off the disappearance of random sentences in historical books. Then as the books changed to entirely blank pages, the disappearances became difficult to ignore, particularly those involving ancient or critical text. Driven by the desire to preserve knowledge, you have made it your purpose to restore and reverse those vanishing texts before they forever disappear.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sage.i.zh: 起初，你將歷史書籍中隨機消失的句子視為自己的幻想，但當書頁逐漸變成一片空白時，這種消失現象變得無法忽視，尤其是那些涉及古代或關鍵文本的部分。為了保存知識，你立志恢復並逆轉這種情況，防止它們永遠消失。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sailor.en: You worked on a ship that might have been a merchant cog, a mercenary or military craft, or a pirate vessel. You might have been a deckhand, a mate, or even the captain.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sailor.zh: 你曾在船上工作，無論是商船、傭兵船、軍艦，還是海盜船。你可能是甲板水手、大副，甚至是船長。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sailor.en: You joined up with your best friend, sibling, or other loved one, the culmination of a lifelong dream to sail the high seas together. When they died, you lost your taste for the seafaring life. You left at the first opportunity and haven’t looked back since.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sailor.zh: 你與最好的朋友、兄弟姐妹或摯愛一同加入船隊，實現航行公海的畢生夢想。在他們死後，你對航海生活徹底失去興趣。你找到機會就立刻離開，再也沒有回頭。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sailor.en: It was in the middle of a pirate raid (whether you were part of it or targeted by it) that you realized you no longer yearned for a sailor’s life. You used the chaos of the moment to slip away unnoticed. You now work as a hero in an effort to either end the piracy of others or atone for your past deeds, but you fear the day your old crew finds you and punishes you for your desertion.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sailor.zh: 在一次海盜襲擊中（無論你是加害者還是受害者），你意識到自己不再渴望水手的生活，你趁亂悄然離開。如今你成為了一名英雄，致力於終止他人的海盜行徑或為自己的過去贖罪。然而，你始終害怕前船員有朝一日會找到你，並因為你的逃逸行為而懲罰你。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sailor.en: You awoke aboard your ship with no memory of who you were. Though the other sailors insisted they knew you, you didn’t know them. The next time you went ashore, you decided to stay, determined to find out who you really are.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sailor.zh: 你在船上醒來，對自己的身分毫無記憶。雖然其他水手聲稱認識你，但你對他們沒有絲毫印象。在下次靠岸時，你決定留在陸地上，決心發掘自己的真正身分。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sailor.en: You had the favor of your captain, which earned you many rivals aboard your ship. One night, your fellow sailors pulled you from your bunk and threw you overboard. By some miracle, you were scooped from the waters by a passing vessel. You worked off your debt to them, then set out on a new life with less pettiness.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sailor.zh: 你擁有船長的青睞，這讓你在船上招來許多競爭對手。在一個夜晚，你的同伴將你從床鋪中拖出來並丟進海裡。幸運的是，一艘路過的船隻救了你。你透過工作償還了欠他們的恩情，然後展開一段遠離瑣碎糾紛的新生活。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sailor.en: There was a mutiny, and you were on the losing side. You were marooned on an island and escaped when a merchant vessel was blown off course by a storm and found you. Your reputation is ruined among sailors, so you seek adventure elsewhere.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sailor.zh: 船上發生了叛變，你不幸站在失敗的一方。你被拋棄在一座孤島上，直到一艘被風暴吹離航道的商船發現你，才讓你得以脫險。如今你在水手圈中的聲譽已毀，因此只能在別處尋求冒險。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sailor.en: A catastrophic storm hit while you were at sea, destroying your ship and leaving you as the only survivor. Once you recovered, you tried to sign on with another ship, but the thought of the open water turned your legs to jelly. Instead, you’ve taken on the role of a traveling hero to make ends meet.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.sailor.zh: 一場風暴災難在海上襲擊了你的船隻，將其摧毀，只留下你一人倖存。康復後，你嘗試重新上船工作，但一想到茫茫大海就讓你雙腿發軟。因此，你轉而成為一名旅行英雄來維持生計。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.soldie.en: You enlisted in the military to protect others, but your commander ordered you to beat and kill civilians. When you refused, things got violent. You barely escaped the brawl that ensued, but now you vow to help people on your own terms.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.soldie.zh: 你入伍從軍是為了保護他人，但你的指揮官卻命令你毆打並殺害平民。你拒絕執行，但事情變得暴力，你勉強從隨後的混戰中逃脫，如今立誓要以自己的方式幫助他人。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.soldie.en: You had a long and storied career as a soldier before deciding to retire to a simpler life. But when you returned to your old home, you found your enemies had laid waste to it. Now the skills you earned on the battlefield are helping you as you become a different kind of warrior - one seeking to save others from the fate you suffered.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.soldie.zh: 你曾有過漫長而輝煌的士兵生涯，最終決定退休過上簡單生活。然而，當你回到家鄉時，卻發現故鄉已被敵人夷為平地。如今，你憑藉戰場上習得的技能致力於拯救他人，避免他們遭受你所經歷的悲劇。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.soldie.en: The sight of constant bloodshed took its toll on you. You seek peace through healing and dedicated yourself to ending wars before they begin, to spare those around you from the horror.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.soldie.zh: 長期身處血腥戰場已經對你造成沉重的負擔。你透過治療他人來尋求平靜，並致力於在戰爭爆發前阻止衝突，讓你身邊的人免於戰爭帶來的恐怖與苦難。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.soldie.en: You were the last surviving member of your unit after an arduous battle or monstrous assault, surviving only through luck. You turned away from the life of a soldier then, seeking to become a hero who could stand against such threats.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.soldie.zh: 在一場艱苦的戰役或可怕的怪物襲擊後，你成為你的單位中唯一的倖存者，純粹靠運氣活了下來。此後，你告別了士兵的生涯，立志成為能夠對抗這類威脅的英雄。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.soldie.en: Tired of eking out an existence on the streets, you enrolled in the military. However, you were unable to escape your lower-status background until the officer leading your unit fell in battle. In the chaos that ensued, you assumed their identity and returned home a hero. To avoid suspicion, you took on the life of an adventurer, staying always on the move.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.soldie.zh: 你厭倦了街頭掙扎求生的日子，加入了軍隊。然而，你始終無法擺脫低微的出身，直到你部隊的軍官在戰鬥中陣亡。在隨後的混亂中，你假冒了該軍官的身分，以英雄之姿返鄉。但是懷疑聲四起，你決定踏上冒險的生活，不斷遷徙，保持流動。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.soldie.en: You promised a fellow soldier that you’d protect his family if he ever fell in battle. When he did, you traveled to his village, but found its people slain or scattered by war. Driven by your vow, you have dedicated your life to finding any survivors and protecting others from a similar fate.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.soldie.zh: 你曾向戰友承諾，若他戰死沙場，你會保護他的家人。當他真的犧牲後，你前往他的村莊，卻發現村民因為戰爭而被殺害或驅散。你受到誓言的驅使，致力於尋找倖存者，並保護他人免受相似的命運。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.warden.en: When outsiders arrived in your lands with the intent to exploit the wilds for their resources, you spoke out against them. However, several other wardens spoke in favor of these outsiders and allowed them in to despoil nature. Refusing to watch your homeland destroyed, you left. Now you help others avoid such a fate.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.warden.zh: 外來者帶著開採自然資源的意圖進入你的領地，而你公開表示反對，但其他幾位守望者卻支持這些外來者，並允許他們破壞自然環境。你無法忍受眼睜睜地看著家園被毀滅，因此選擇離開。如今，你致力於幫助他人避免遭遇相同的命運。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.warden.en: A disease has infected the lands you protect, causing animals to become violent and twisting plants into something dark and sinister. You’ve tried everything, magical and mundane, to stop the scourge, but it continues to spread. As such, you’ve set out in search of a cure or an unblighted land to protect.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.warden.zh: 一種疾病感染了你所保護的土地，導致動物變得暴力，植物扭曲成邪惡形態。你嘗試了各種魔法和非魔法手段，卻無法阻止這場災難蔓延。因此，你踏上旅程，尋找解藥，或尋找一片尚未受污染、可供你守護的土地。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.warden.en: You made a mistake that could not be forgiven. The other wardens of the region decided your fate, exiling you from your lands with an order never to return.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.warden.zh: 你犯下了不可饒恕的過錯。這片地區的其他守望者決定了你的命運，將你驅逐，並命令你永遠不得歸返。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.warden.en: A group of heroes arrived in your territory with trouble close on their heels. You fought alongside them to turn back the evil, but it was too much. The heroes fell, and your wilderness was forever altered. Though your lands are beyond saving, there are other lands you can help.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.warden.zh: 一群英雄抵達了你的領地，但麻煩也緊隨其後。你與他們並肩作戰抵抗邪惡，但敵人實在太過強大。英雄們犧牲了，你的荒野也永遠改變。儘管你的土地已經無法挽救，但世上還有其他地方需要你的幫助。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.warden.en: There were signs. You tried to ignore them, but when a great beast died at your feet, you had to recognize the truth. You were meant to leave your home territory, meant to fight a battle for the fate of all lands - and so you gave up the only life you’ve ever known.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.warden.zh: 你試圖忽視曾經出現過的徵兆，但當一頭巨獸死在你腳邊時，你不得不承認事實。你命中註定要離開家園，註定要為所有土地的命運而戰，因此你放棄了唯一熟悉的生活方式。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.warden.en: You were responsible for guarding something precious, something vital to your region’s survival. But you let someone in, and they betrayed your trust by stealing the thing you were meant to guard. You left your chosen territory to atone for your mistake.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.warden.zh: 你負責守護一件珍貴之物，它對你所在地區的生存至關重要。你讓某人進入領地，對方卻背叛了你的信任，偷走你本應保護的寶物。為了彌補自己的過錯，你離開了自己守護的領地。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.watch-.en: You grew bored and disillusioned with chasing down petty thieves and imprisoning folks just trying to survive. Surely there are greater threats in the world. You will find that evil wherever it may lurk, and you’ll be the one to stop it.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.watch-.zh: 你對追捕小偷，以及將那些僅為求生而掙扎的人關進牢裡的工作感到厭倦與失望。世界上肯定存在著更大的威脅。你決心找出那些潛伏的真正邪惡，並成為終結它們的人。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.watch-.en: You joined the force to help the helpless and bring justice to those wronged. You weren’t prepared for the rampant corruption reaching the top of your organization. You refused to cover for your fellow officers and were told in no simple terms to leave town or face the consequences. Now you travel as a hero, acting as the protector you always wanted to be.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.watch-.zh: 你加入守望隊是為了幫助弱者，為受害者伸張正義，但你沒有料到組織高層是多麼猖獗腐敗。當你拒絕掩飾同僚的不法行為時，你收到了明確的警告：馬上離開城鎮，否則後果自負。如今，你以英雄身分遊歷四方，終於成為了你一直嚮往的守護者。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.watch-.en: Your partner was murdered. That much is irrefutable. But you didn’t do it, despite what the evidence implies. When it became clear you’d take the fall, you fled, leaving everything behind. Not content to cower in the shadows, you decided to adventure under a new name while you work to clear your own.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.watch-.zh: 你的夥伴被謀殺了，而這是無可爭辯的事實。儘管證據都指向你，但你並非兇手。當你意識到自己將成為代罪羔羊時，你逃亡了，拋下了一切。你不願躲藏在陰影中度日，決定以新的名字踏上冒險之路，同時致力於洗清自己的罪名。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.watch-.en: You learned everything you know about the job from someone you always looked up to in a corrupt organization. One night, they sent you a cryptic message saying they had discovered “something big,” but before you found out more, they disappeared. No longer sure who you could trust, you slipped away and sought a new life. Now you do what good you can and search to find the truth.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.watch-.zh: 你這份工作的所有知識都來自一位你深深敬仰的導師，但他身處一個腐敗的組織。一天晚上，你收到他發來的一條神祕訊息，聲稱發現了「重大的事情」，但在你能了解詳情前，他就突然消失了。你不知道還能信任誰，於是悄悄離開，踏上了新的旅程。如今，你一邊盡力行善，一邊尋找真相。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.watch-.en: A particularly violent or depraved criminal began targeting you - perhaps stealing something personal or hurting someone you love - after slipping through your grasp. You left your career to pursue the criminal, but the trail has gone cold … for now. Might as well help folk in the meantime.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.watch-.zh: 一名暴力或墮落的罪犯從你手中逃脫後就開始針對你，他可能偷走了你的重要物品，或傷害了你所愛的人。為了抓住這個罪犯，你放棄了原本的職業，但目前線索已經斷了。既然如此，你決定在繼續追查的同時，幫助那些有需要的人。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.watch-.en: You made it your responsibility to root out and bring down the region’s foremost crime syndicate. They sent goons to burn down your home and teach you a lesson, leaving you bleeding in the street with nothing left except your life. You’ve since taken on the life of a hero to gain the power and influence you need to destroy the syndicate once and for all.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.career.watch-.zh: 你肩負了根除該地區主要犯罪集團的責任，但他們派打手燒毀你的家，並痛打你一頓，讓你血流不止地躺在街頭，除了性命以外已經一無所有。此後，你選擇了英雄之路，致力於獲得足夠的力量和影響力，徹底摧毀這個犯罪集團。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.envir.en: A nomadic culture travels from place to place to survive.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.envir.zh: 遊牧文化為了生存而不斷從一個地方遷移到另一個地方。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.envir.en: A rural culture is one located in a town, village, or smaller settled enclave.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.envir.zh: 鄉村文化存在於小鎮、村莊或更小的聚落。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.envir.en: A secluded culture is based in one relatively close-quarters structure — a building, a cavern, and so forth — and interacts with other cultures only rarely.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.envir.zh: 隱居文化存在於單一且相對狹小的結構中（例如建築物或洞穴），幾乎不會與外界文化有所互動。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.envir.en: An urban culture is always centered in a city.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.envir.zh: 城市文化始終以城市為中心。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.envir.en: A wilderness culture doesn’t try to tame the terrain in which its people live, whether desert, forest, swamp, tundra, ocean, or more exotic climes.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.envir.zh: 荒野文化的人民不會試圖征服他們居住的地方，無論是沙漠、森林、沼澤、凍原、海洋，還是更特殊的環境。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.organ.en: Bureaucratic cultures are steeped in official leadership and formally recorded laws.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.organ.zh: 官僚文化深深根植於正式的領導制度與成文法律。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.organ.en: A communal culture is a place where all members of the culture are considered equal.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.organ.zh: 平權文化是一個所有成員皆平等的地方。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.upbri.en: Your hero was raised by people who collect, study, and share books and other records.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.upbri.zh: 你的英雄由那些收藏、研讀並分享書籍與其他紀錄的人們撫養長大。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.upbri.en: A hero with a creative upbringing was raised among folk who create art or other works valuable enough to trade.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.upbri.zh: 擁有創作成長經歷的英雄是在善於創作藝術或其他具有交易價值作品的群體中長大的。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.upbri.en: Your hero came of age in a culture where people labored for a living.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.upbri.zh: 你的英雄成長於一個靠勞動為生的文化中。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.upbri.en: Your hero grew up among folk who performed activities that other people — whether within or outside their culture — considered unlawful.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.upbri.zh: 你的英雄在一群從事被他人（無論在其文化內外）視為非法活動的人們中長大。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.upbri.en: A hero with a martial upbringing was raised by warriors.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.upbri.zh: 擁有尚武成長經歷的英雄從小在戰士的薰陶下成長。

fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.upbri.en: Your hero grew up among leaders who rule over others and play the games of politics to maintain power.
fs-adapt:heroes.background.culture.upbri.zh: 你的英雄成長於那些統治他人並運用政治手段維持權力的領導者之中。

fs-adapt:heroes.perks.arcane-trick.effec.en: Choose one of the following effects:
You teleport a size 1S or smaller object adjacent to you into an unoccupied space adjacent to you.
fs-adapt:heroes.perks.arcane-trick.effec.zh: 你將 1 個體型 1S 以下且與你相鄰的物體傳送至 1 個與你相鄰的未占據空間。

fs-adapt:heroes.perks.arcane-trick.effec.en: Until the start of your next turn, a part of your body shoots a shower of harmless noisy sparks that light up each square adjacent to you.
fs-adapt:heroes.perks.arcane-trick.effec.zh: 在你下個回合開始前，你身體的 1 個部位會射出無害的吵雜火花，照亮每個與你相鄰的方格。

fs-adapt:heroes.perks.arcane-trick.effec.en: You ignite or snuff out (your choice) every mundane light source of 1L or smaller adjacent to you.
fs-adapt:heroes.perks.arcane-trick.effec.zh: 你點燃或熄滅每個與你相鄰、體型為 1L 以下的尋常光源。

fs-adapt:heroes.perks.arcane-trick.effec.en: You transform up to 1 pound of edible food you touch to make it taste delicious or disgusting.
fs-adapt:heroes.perks.arcane-trick.effec.zh: 你觸碰最多 1 磅的可食用食物，使其味道變得美味或噁心。

fs-adapt:heroes.perks.arcane-trick.effec.en: Until the start of your next turn, you make your body exude a particular odor you’ve smelled before. This smell can be sensed by each creature within 5 squares of you, but can’t impose any condition or other drawback on those creatures.
fs-adapt:heroes.perks.arcane-trick.effec.zh: 在你下個回合開始前，你的身體會散發出 1 種你曾經聞過的氣味。在你 5 格內的每個生物都能聞到這個氣味，但不會因此陷入任何狀態或受到不良影響。

fs-adapt:heroes.perks.arcane-trick.effec.en: You place a small magical inscription on the surface of a mundane object you touch, or you can remove an inscription that was made by you or by another creature using Arcane Trick.
fs-adapt:heroes.perks.arcane-trick.effec.zh: 你觸碰 1 個尋常物體的表面並留下小型魔法銘文，或移除由你或其他生物使用【奧術戲法】留下的任何銘文。

fs-adapt:heroes.perks.arcane-trick.effec.en: You touch a size 1T object to cover it with an illusion that makes it look like a different object. Any creature who handles the object becomes aware of the illusion. The illusion ends when you stop touching the object.
fs-adapt:heroes.perks.arcane-trick.effec.zh: 你觸碰 1 個體型 1T 的物體，用幻術讓它的外觀變成其他物體。任何與該物體互動的生物都會察覺此幻術。當你不再觸碰該物體時，幻術就會消失。

fs-adapt:heroes.perks.arcane-trick.effec.en: You cast an entertaining spell that creates a minor but impressive magical effect.
fs-adapt:heroes.perks.arcane-trick.effec.zh: 你施展一個趣味的法術，創造出微小但令人驚豔的魔法效果。
